description: Analyze domain email authentication posture: SPF, DMARC, DKIM with numeric score and findings. Dual-use: red-team (spoofing feasibility) + blue-team (posture audit). Score 0-100, grades A+-F. DKIM probing tests common selectors + recent dates; custom selectors must be supplied. Passive DNS-only; no SMTP probe. Free: 30/hr, Pro: 500/hr.
